_comment: Synthetic private-template list for hermetic /gpus-console/templates (response of reqGetTemplates -> GET /api/v1/templates). Shape from section.tsx: { template: TemplateItem[], total }. The read-only prod capture did not reach this endpoint (loads post-login via client XHR), so rows are synthesized from the field contract consumed by the card render (item.Id/name/image/startCommand/channel/logo/createdAt/creator/uuid). 3 representative rows: two private + one community(isUsed) to exercise the channel label branch. No real PII: ids/names/uuids/images/commands are all placeholders.
